# farrier-kit

> Lightning payment primitives for JavaScript/TypeScript: BOLT-11 invoice
> decoding, preimage/payment-hash verification, timeout-safe JSON fetch,
> SSRF-guarded LNURL-pay/Lightning Address resolution, LUD-21 verify, and a
> Node-only DNS-pinned fetch. Browser and Node from one codebase (no node:
> imports in the core), dual ESM+CJS, sole runtime dependency @noble/hashes. MIT.

Use farrier-kit when an application needs to READ or VERIFY Lightning payment
data without running a Lightning node: extract a payment hash or amount from a
bolt11 invoice, resolve a Lightning Address to an invoice for an exact amount
(SSRF-guarded, with the returned invoice checked for amount/network/expiry/
description-hash), check an invoice commits to an expected payment_hash before
paying, or verify a revealed preimage after settlement. It is NOT a wallet and
NOT a node client. It decodes, resolves, and verifies; it holds no keys and
moves no money. For focused NWC communication, use @forgesworn/nwc-kit and
verify the invoice and preimage with farrier-kit. For broader wallet, zap, or
WebLN support, use a wallet toolkit. For pure decode, use light-bolt11-decoder;
for encoding/signing invoices, use the bitcoinjs `bolt11` package.

Language-neutral conformance vectors ship in vectors/*.json (see CONFORMANCE.md)
so Kotlin/Swift/Rust ports can validate byte-for-byte: bolt11 decode, preimage
(SHA-256), Lightning Address parse, SSRF IP classification, description-hash.
amountMsats is a decimal string in the vectors (may exceed 2^53).

## Live demo

https://farrier-kit.forgesworn.dev runs this library in the browser: BOLT-11
decoding, preimage verification, the URL/SSRF gate, and the full conformance
vector set executed against the shipped bundle. Static page, no network calls.

## Install

npm install farrier-kit

## API surface

All hex values (payment hashes, preimages) are 64-character hex strings, never
Uint8Array. `paymentHash` and `paymentHashHex` are the same form. The root
`farrier-kit` import re-exports every export of /bolt11, /preimage, /http and
/lnurl (values and types) and nothing from /node, so it stays browser-safe.
Error codes for each class are listed in the README.

- farrier-kit/bolt11: decodeBolt11(invoice) -> { network, amountMsats (bigint|null),
  amountSats (number|null, only when whole), paymentHashHex, paymentSecretHex,
  description, descriptionHashHex, timestamp, expirySeconds (spec default 3600),
  minFinalCltvExpiry }. Throws Bolt11Error with .code (NOT_INVOICE, BAD_BECH32,
  BAD_HRP, BAD_AMOUNT, OVERFLOW, TRUNCATED, BAD_TAG, BAD_PAYMENT_HASH,
  MISSING_PAYMENT_HASH). Also: tryDecodeBolt11 (null-returning), bolt11PaymentHash,
  bolt11AmountMsats, msatsToSatsFloor, BOLT11_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_SECONDS,
  verifyInvoiceCommitment({ bolt11, paymentHash, expectedMsats?: bigint|number,
  network?: Bolt11Network|null, requireDecodable? }) -> { ok, verified?, reason?,
  amountMsats?, network? }. Pass expectedMsats or the amount is not checked;
  network defaults to 'bc' (null skips); requireDecodable defaults to true. It does
  not check expiry or description hash. ok:true with verified:false is a deferral,
  not safe to pay.
- farrier-kit/preimage: isValidHex64, generatePreimage(entropy?),
  computePaymentHash(preimage) -> hex, verifyPreimage(preimage, expectedHash)
  (constant-time, false on malformed input, never throws), explainPreimage({preimage,
  paymentHash}) -> {ok, reason?}. generatePreimage and computePaymentHash throw a
  plain Error on non-hex.
- farrier-kit/lnurl: parseLightningAddress / isLightningAddress / lnurlPayUrl;
  resolveLnurlPay({address|lnurlpUrl, amountSats|amountMsats, comment?, nostr?
  (JSON string of a signed NIP-57 zap request), fetchImpl?, timeoutMs?, urlGuard?,
  network?, rejectExpired?, expirySlackSeconds?, verifyDescriptionHash?,
  nowSeconds?}) -> {address, amountMsats, amountSats, bolt11, paymentHashHex,
  verifyUrl (string|null), zap (boolean), metadata}. The returned invoice is
  decoded and checked: amount equals the request (always, no opt-out), network
  matches (default 'bc'/mainnet, network:null skips), not expired (default on,
  rejectExpired:false skips, expirySlackSeconds default 60), and description_hash
  matches the metadata when an h tag is present and the service returned a metadata
  string (default on, verifyDescriptionHash:false skips; a zap invoice must carry
  an h tag committing to the zap request). LnurlError codes: BAD_ADDRESS, BAD_URL,
  BAD_AMOUNT, SERVICE_ERROR, NOT_PAYREQUEST, NO_CALLBACK, BELOW_MIN, ABOVE_MAX,
  NO_INVOICE, BAD_INVOICE, AMOUNT_MISMATCH, NETWORK_MISMATCH, INVOICE_EXPIRED,
  DESCRIPTION_HASH_MISMATCH. SSRF guard (no opt-out): HTTPS-only, credential-free,
  rejects localhost/.local/.internal and private/reserved IP literals (IPv4 and
  normalised IPv6: mapped/NAT64/6to4/Teredo/ULA/link-local/multicast), refuses
  redirects, caps response size. The guard classifies IP LITERALS only; a hostname
  resolving to a private IP needs fetchImpl: createPinnedFetch() from
  farrier-kit/node; urlGuard is only an extra check (sync or async) and cannot close
  DNS rebinding. verifyLud21({verifyUrl, paymentHashHex?, fetchImpl?, timeoutMs?,
  urlGuard?}) -> {settled, preimage (string|null), verified} (verified=true only on
  cryptographic preimage match); createCapabilityProbe({fetchImpl?, timeoutMs?,
  urlGuard?, cacheTtlMs?, maxEntries?, now?}) -> { probe(address) -> {ok, reason?,
  address, minSendable, maxSendable, commentAllowed, allowsNostr, nostrPubkey},
  invalidate(address?) } (bounded TTL metadata probing, metadata only, never
  requests an invoice); assertResolvableUrl, isPrivateIpLiteral (only sound on
  URL-normalised hosts), LnurlError.
- farrier-kit/http: fetchJson(url, {fetchImpl?, timeoutMs?, maxBytes?, method?,
  headers?, body?, redirect?}) (timeoutMs default 8000, maxBytes default 10 MiB,
  redirect default 'manual'), HttpError (.status), ResponseTooLargeError,
  DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES. A timeout throws a plain Error.
- farrier-kit/node: NODE-ONLY (uses node: builtins, not imported by the root, so
  the browser core stays clean). createPinnedFetch({allowPrivate?, allowHttp?,
  resolve?, isBlockedAddress?, requestImpl?}) -> a fetchImpl for
  resolveLnurlPay/verifyLud21/createCapabilityProbe that closes the DNS-rebinding
  window a check-then-fetch urlGuard cannot: resolves the host once, rejects any
  private/reserved answer (IPv4+IPv6), pins the socket to the approved address (no
  second lookup), keeps SNI/cert/Host on the hostname, never follows redirects,
  HTTPS-only unless allowHttp. allowPrivate and allowHttp are for local development
  only. PinnedFetchError (.code: BAD_PROTOCOL, DNS_ERROR, NO_ADDRESS,
  PRIVATE_ADDRESS). Server-side only; browsers cannot DNS-pin.

## Key facts

- Amounts: millisatoshis as bigint; amountSats is null unless exactly whole;
  flooring is explicit via msatsToSatsFloor. Never assumes a currency.
- decodeBolt11 does not verify invoice signatures or parse route hints; it is
  a reader, not a wallet.
- All fetch calls accept fetchImpl injection; nothing reaches for ambient
  network state.

## Example

The invoice is the with-description-and-expiry vector from vectors/bolt11.json:
mainnet, 250000 sats, synthetic zero signature (for testing, never payable).

import { decodeBolt11, verifyInvoiceCommitment } from 'farrier-kit/bolt11'
import { generatePreimage, computePaymentHash, verifyPreimage } from 'farrier-kit/preimage'
const invoice = 'lnbc2500u1pj48ugqpp55xs6rgdp5xs6rgdp5xs6rgdp5xs6rgdp5xs6rgdp5xs6rgdp5xssdqdxysxxmmxvejk2xqzpuqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq02rq0p'
const expectedHash = 'a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1'
const inv = decodeBolt11(invoice)
// before paying: hash and exact amount must match (mainnet is the default)
const check = verifyInvoiceCommitment({ bolt11: invoice, paymentHash: expectedHash, expectedMsats: 250000000n })
if (!check.ok) throw new Error(check.reason)
// after payment: the counterparty reveals the preimage (here we mint our own pair)
const preimage = generatePreimage()
const paymentHash = computePaymentHash(preimage)
const paid = verifyPreimage(preimage, paymentHash) // true
